message.content: I'm keeping my $306 in cash and ending the turn. Next roll I could land on p1's red properties 10 to 13 spaces ahead, where rent runs up to $600 (Illinois, 2 houses), and Park Place and Boardwalk are still coming later. Unmortgaging all three oranges would cost $308, which I don't have, and doing just one or two would bring in very little rent.
message.reasoning:
With $306 and all my orange properties mortgaged, unmortgaging all three would cost $308 — just short, so I can only do two. The real threat is far down the board: Park Place with three houses and Boardwalk with four houses could hit me for over a thousand each, but I'm still near St Charles so that danger isn't immediate.

The closer risk zone is Illinois, Indiana, and Kentucky, all with houses built, and they're well within dice range from my current position. I think it's safer to hold onto my cash rather than unmortgage anything right now and just end my turn.
